propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (e.g. --body-file, --body) as positional body argument and stores them literally instead of rejecting them
when a flag-like token is stored as body, the intended actual content is silently discarded and the command exits 0, making data loss undetectable until content is read downstream

positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) lack validation to reject arguments beginning with dash, enabling the same failure mode across multiple commands
the -- escape hatch allows legitimate body values beginning with dash to be passed without being misinterpreted as flags
the command-parsing layer silently truncates surplus positionals via args[:min_args] slice, compounding data loss when a flag token is stored and the actual value follows
